method: Offline actual Runtime packets, deep frozen and replayed into the same fresh scene A disabled / B enabled. No repeated Runtime.advance for A/B; render dt 1/60. Screenshot fixture freezes camera smoothing and ambient RNG equally.

provenance.note: Metadata attached after this completed A/B run; the original probe omitted these fields. HTML SHA was measured before any subsequent build. Browser version comes from the S1 report using the identical standard Playwright Chromium binary and browserOptions. Final comment-only rebuild must match HTML SHA before reusing either report.
